errorType: ESM not configurable — vi.spyOn on @ngrx/store select
symptom: TypeError: Unable to lift unknown Observable type — ngrx Store is an Observable subclass; store.pipe(select(...)) calls RxJS lift() internally which requires a proper OperatorFunction. A plain arrow function returned by the select mock does not satisfy this contract.
fix: Drop vi.mock("@ngrx/store") and the select mock entirely. Instead spy at the store level: `vi.spyOn(store, "pipe").mockReturnValueOnce(of(value))`. This bypasses the operator lifting problem and avoids the ESM non-configurability of @ngrx/store.

Jasmine residual — .calls.argsFor()
fix: Replace `spy["calls"].argsFor(n)[i]` with `vi.mocked(spy).mock.calls[n][i]`. Jasmine `.calls.argsFor(n)` returns the arguments of the nth call; the Vitest equivalent is `.mock.calls[n]` (zero-indexed array of argument arrays).

errorType: Jasmine residual — throwError/reset on spy
fix: Replace `.and.throwError(msg)` with `mockImplementationOnce(function() { throw new Error(msg); } as any)`. Must use `function` keyword not arrow function — the stub is called with `new` so arrow functions are not valid constructors.

BroadcastChannel API mocks not set up correctly
fix: `vi.spyOn(window, "BroadcastChannel")` does not intercept bare `new BroadcastChannel()` in Angular services. Use `vi.stubGlobal("BroadcastChannel", vi.fn().mockImplementation(function() { return mockChannel; }))`. Arrow functions cannot be used as constructors. Add `afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); })` to prevent leaking. Assert on bare `BroadcastChannel`, not `window.BroadcastChannel`.

EnvironmentInjector.destroy() clashes with TestBed teardown
fix: Calling `TestBed.inject(EnvironmentInjector).destroy()` destroys the root injector that TestBed also destroys in afterEach, causing NG0205. Fix: create an independent child with `createEnvironmentInjector([ServiceClass], TestBed.inject(EnvironmentInjector))` and destroy that. The child injector is owned by the test so its destruction does not conflict with TestBed cleanup.
